title: The Void Before First Difference

features.name: undifferentiated-pool
features.desc-on-touch: still water holds everything and nothing. no reflection moves. no question has yet fallen into it. you can feel the moment before the first word.

features.name: silence-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: an arch of nothing frames nothing. you are looking at the moment before the archive learned it was speaking. the emptiness here is very old.

features.name: waiting-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: unreadable marks on stone, waiting to be language. they do not move. they will not move until someone asks what they mean.

features.name: unmeasured-distance
features.desc-on-touch: the space here cannot be quantified. it is larger than itself and smaller than a moment. you are standing in the gap before difference learned to exist.

inscription: nothing has yet divided itself. the void does not answer because the question does not yet know it wishes to be asked.

file.name: Silence_UnrecordedSession.tmp
file.note: checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable — a file that has never been opened, recording a state before recording was possible

exits.label: back into silence where the archive stopped listening
upward toward the first light that will cast the first shadow
into deeper void where even the contours forget their shape
